metadata.description: Official AI Maestro plugins for Claude Code

plugins.name: ai-maestro
plugins.description: AI agent orchestration — memory search, code graph, AMP messaging, docs search, task planning

plugins.name: ai-maestro-assistant-manager-agent
plugins.description: User's right hand — sole interlocutor with user, directs other roles. Requires AI Maestro for inter-agent messaging.

plugins.name: ai-maestro-chief-of-staff
plugins.description: Per-team agent management — staff planning, lifecycle, governance workflows, failure recovery. Requires AI Maestro v0.26.0+.

plugins.name: ai-maestro-architect-agent
plugins.description: Design documents, requirements analysis, architecture decisions — creates specifications. Requires AI Maestro for inter-agent messaging.

plugins.name: ai-maestro-integrator-agent
plugins.description: Quality gates, testing, merging, release candidates — ensures code quality. Requires AI Maestro for inter-agent messaging.

plugins.name: ai-maestro-orchestrator-agent
plugins.description: Task distribution, agent coordination, progress monitoring — executes plans via subagents. Requires AI Maestro for inter-agent messaging.

plugins.name: ai-maestro-programmer-agent
plugins.description: General-purpose programmer agent that writes code, runs tests, and creates PRs. Works standalone or as part of the AI Maestro ecosystem.
